sources.label: Morphe-compatible patches for Radio Indonesia (com.appmind.radios.id): premium u
sources.author: Fakh Radio
patch_list: Turns off Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Performance and Sessions, and the Facebook SDK with its app events.
Stops the location, Wi-Fi and network data SDKs (Weplan, Wavebrook and its partners, Speedchecker, LowLagLabs, GeoTruth) through the app's own off switches.
Stops the splash screen from waiting up to 5 seconds on the Firebase Remote Config fetch. The fetch still finishes in the background.
Unlocks the lifetime premium client-side (no visual ads, music equalizer) and keeps the ad networks and AppHarbr from starting at all, so they cannot track in the background.
Shows the song title and its album art in the media notification and the system media player, instead of the station name with no picture.
